04A place. A people. A possibility.

Where ideas meet
the shoreline.

NITK Surathkal

A campus.
A community.
A wider horizon.

Curiosity has a home
by the Arabian Sea.

TEDxNITKSurathkal began in 2011 with a simple belief: ideas can move a community forward. Here, at NITK, different disciplines and lived experiences find room in the same conversation.
